title.narrative: m - mama Malawi: Critical Emergency Transportation Infrastructure for Pregnant Women and Newborns

description.narrative: 1. Contribution to reduced maternal and neonatal mortality and morbidity, as well as reduced stillbirths, in Malawi
1.1 EmRTS system is setup, well-functioning and improving access to emergency and comprehensive services for pregnant women and neonates
1.1.1 Maternal and newborn emergencies are transported, and are reaching in a timely and cost effective manner to an appropriate health facility and are followed up to track outcomes
1.1.2 Quality maternal and neonatal health services are provided in health facilities by the GoM
1.2 EmRTS system is financed, used and managed effectively by the people of Malawi
1.2.1 Government of Malawi budgets for, manages and operates EmRTS system
1.2.2 Public is aware of the system, is using it and is satisfied with the services

Additional background to this budget and program. The information entered in this platform represents the contribution of funding from FCDO (only). It is not inclusive of other funding sources on this program. Additionally, Last Mile Health was a sub-recipient, under the Vodafone Foundation, for these FCDO funds, however, for ease of accounting, the Vodafone Foundation transferred all FCDO funds on the award to Last Mile Health, and LMH managed a small number of financial transactions on behalf of the Vodafone Foundation that were specific to the Vodafone Foundation expenses.
